comments.author: sgtlaggy
comments.body_html: After adding this mod, existing builds need to be re-saved before other players can see them. Similarly, builds from profiles uploaded via Fika’s API won’t be shown/updated until they’re re-saved.

comments.author: ArchangelWTF
comments.body_html:
I never took fika’s API into consideration to be honest as I never use it myself nor was I aware of it.

The existing builds thing is true, I couldn’t find a decent way to make sure that it’s nicely synced so I just left it as is.
